"''Champala's seas are not what they once were, but yes, of course.|Orson Callan Krennic and Mas Amedda|}} '''Champala''' was a [[Planet|world]] in the [[Champala system]] in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]]. Located on the [[Hydian Way]], it was [[Homeworld|home]] to the [[Chagrian]] [[species]], including [[Mas Amedda]], [[Vice Chair|Vice Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and later [[Grand Vizier]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. A popular [[Time|pastime]] on Champala was [[fishing]], but, according to Amedda, by the [[Clone Wars]] its [[ocean]]s were "not what they once were." Nevertheless, the [[human]] [[architect]] [[Orson Callan Krennic]] used such as an analogy to explain his plans for [[scientist]] [[Galen Walton Erso]] to Amedda. The world had [[Champalan Embassy|its own embassy]] on [[Coruscant]]. During the Clone Wars, Champala hosted a [[Separatist base (Champala)|base]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It was later [[Occupation of Champala|occupied]] by the Galactic Empire. {{Planet-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== In ''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'', Champala is misidentified as Cona.''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]'' ==Appearances== *{{StoryCite|story=The Call of Coruscant|book=The High Republic: Tales of Light and Life|audiobook=1}} {{Mo}} *''[[Star Wars Journeys: Beginnings]]'' {{1stm}} *''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]'' {{Ab|Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *[[Star Wars Zero Company|''Star Wars'' Zero Company]] *[[Doctor Aphra (2020) 18|''Doctor Aphra'' (2020) 18]] {{1st}} {{Flash}} *''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' {{Mo}} {{DLC|''A Pirate's Fortune''}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} {{C|Mentioned in [[Aurebesh]] on [[computer]] screen}} ==Sources== *''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' *{{BuildFalconCite|52|Guide to the Galaxy}} *''[[Lead by Example]]'' *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] {{MapPoint}} *[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] *''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia, New Edition]]'' *''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' *{{GalaxyMapPoster}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{SWYouTube|q0trVP56Cy0|Star Wars Celebration LIVE!
